summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **30%, 55%**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Experiments show a natural trade-off between model accuracy and latency: a smaller model achieves 30% end-state accuracy with 1.3 seconds of latency, while a larger model achieves 55%...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 4 赞），本工作为突破 **高效推理与系统** 中的「推理延迟与高昂计算开销」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。

summaries.title: AnyTeleop: A General Vision-Based Dexterous Robot Arm-Hand Teleoperation System

summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：For real-world experiments, AnyTeleop can outperform a previous system that was designed for a specific robot hardware with a higher success rate, using the same...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（For real-world experiments, AnyTeleop can outperform a previous system that was designed for a specific robot hardware with a higher success rate, using the same robot）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 2 赞），本工作证明了系统级编排/底层执行优化在 **人形控制与真机灵巧操作 (Humanoid & Manip)** 落地中的决定性收益；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。
